notes:
- Error reports: after signing in, unsent errors can be sent to the developer with one click; a GitHub page prefilled with the sanitized report opens in your browser (public; no personal data) and is sent when you submit it
- Home page sections can be resized: narrower or wider and shorter or taller, with buttons or by dragging the corner
- Base currency equivalents (≈) also on the account list, opening balances and day closing; totals rows show one ≈ total for all units
- Backups: the newest 30 backups of all kinds are kept; older ones are deleted automatically
- A transfer package is deleted securely after it has been imported successfully
- The in-app help was rewritten for the current screens (new sections: home page, account list, transfer, error reports) and no longer jumps when opened with F1
- Monthly accruals and payments: a calmer highlight for the remaining line
- Security: a second save pressed while a record is still being saved no longer creates a duplicate record
- LedgerPro now runs only from a USB disk (flash drive, external USB SSD or hard disk). Started from a computer's fixed disk it cannot be set up; existing data there opens read only so you can move it to a USB disk with a transfer package
- Choose the base currency in the last setup step; sample data is created in the chosen currency
- Importing opening balances from Excel: a transaction category is now required on every balance line
- Cash flow report and home page card: weekly, monthly, yearly or a chosen date range
- Cash flow chart: collections are shown in green and payments in red, matching the legend
- Backups can be deleted from the Backup screen (main password required; the file is wiped)
- Updates also work when the program folder is read-only: the read-only attribute is removed automatically (your data, backups and transfer packages are not touched)
